hotspots.title: AfD’s extremism and legal battles escalate
hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party faces growing legal scrutiny and internal divisions, with courts upholding surveillance of the party due to extremist ties. hotspots.affect: This story commands attention due to its polarized contention over Vox's policies, moral charge surrounding its nationalist rhetoric, and the alarmist framing of its potential to reshape Spain's political and social fabric.
